item.title: Stock market prediction for tomorrow: Sensex, Nifty outlook for Tuesday | Kospi, Taiwan cues to watch | 29 Sept 2026
item.description: On September 28, the Indian stock market faced significant selling pressure, with indices dropping due to rising crude oil prices and global monetary tightening fears. The Nifty 50 fell 1.54%, closing below 23,000 for the first time since April, as multiple sectors showed losses.

item.title: Kalpataru Projects shares rise 2.5% despite market sell-off | Here’s what’s in focus
item.description: Kalpataru Projects International share price rose 2.5% on September 28 after the listing of its subsidiary, Linjemontage i Grastorp AB, on Nasdaq Stockholm. KPIL remains a majority stakeholder, holding approximately 65.9% in LMG, which successfully completed its IPO at SEK 46 per share.

item.title: SBI Life, HDFC Life, ICICI Prudential: Should you invest in insurance stocks amid IRDAI new reforms? Experts suggestion
item.description: Prathamesh Kadival, Research Analyst at Bonanza, believes that India's insurance sector is entering an important phase as IRDAI pushes for lower costs, greater transparency and better value for policyholders

item.title: Reliance shares hit a fresh 52-week low; stock plunges 24% YTD - Time to buy or stay away?
item.description: Reliance Industries has hit a fresh 52-week low at ₹1,198 amid a broader market selloff. Despite strong earnings, concerns over retail growth and capital expenditures loom large, leading experts to debate whether it’s time to buy or stay cautious.

item.title: Dr Lal PathLabs adds genomics heft with SN Genelab deal
item.description: SN Genelab’s testing capabilities could gain wider reach through Dr Lal's network over time, potentially boosting growth

item.title: SMC Global Securities shares surge 18% to 52-week high | What’s behind the jump?
item.description: SMC Global Securities share price soared 18% on September 28, reaching a 52-week high amid a broader market sell-off. The stock gained attention for acting as a market maker for SME IPOs, including Kheria Autocomp, and has shown significant growth in recent months.
